scripts.build: dotnet build RecipeApp.slnx && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.dev:api: node --env-file=.env tools\run-with-env.mjs dotnet run --project apps\api\src\RecipeApp.Api --launch-profile https -- --ObjectStorage:BucketName=recipe-images-dev
